company_info.company_description: "At Sunshine State Solar and Electrical, we’re more than just a solar company; we’re a community of passionate individuals committed to making a difference. Whether you’re looking to reduce your energy bills, increase your property value, or contribute to a cleaner environment, we’re here to help you achieve your solar dreams."

reviews.review_description: Went through multiple iterations of quotes as I was exploring value for money set ups. Did not have any issues with the quotes and sign up process was quick and easy. Communication was good and installation was relatively straightforward. Can recommend.

It was great dealing with Christian and Gina.  The install team were excellent and got it all installed, up and running in half a day.Had 3 quotes provided through here, however I approached Sunshine State Solar and I was immediately impressed, they were professional, fast and thorough, and for similar products they provided much better value for money. Had my system installed within a week of accepting. Some of the others hadn't even followed me up on the quote provided weeks before.
Knowledgeable and helpful sales person (PK). The install crew were quick and polite, and tidied up well. The price was good. All in all a great experience. Highly recommended.

Sales person was helpful and went out of their way to ascertain my requirement and provide a detailed quote. The installation was carried out on agreed date in a quick and tidy manner and left the site in a clean state.As the installation was for a like for like replacement, the final installation was much tidier that the original (7 panel to replace the original 16).
Sunshine State Solar made the process very easy. They were prompt, efficient and professional. They even sent me txts showing a live map of the vehicle on its way to do the install!
Non pushy sale staff with their installation teamEmployees of the business.

Honestly this would have been a 5 star review had it not been for the significant damage to my roof that was caused by the installation by Sunshine State Solar and safety practicesThe Boys were friendly and respectful, wiring and actual electrical work seem to be of high standard.Unfortunatley there has been significant damage to my near new roof at the access points and around the new system. the damage is clearly visible from the front of the property and its pretty hard to ignore. I notified Sunshine State Solar of the issue immediately and was told they will talk to their workers to see what happened and get back to me. that was close to 2 months ago with no follow up from their side. after a number of emails, I did get a reply to my email this morning saying that the damage is unavoidable and they arent accepting liability and that I should be making a claim on my home insurance as they arent going to be paying for it.I'm a tradie in the insurance repair industry and have been working on rooves for 20 years and have never seen solar guys damage a roof like this, particularly on the thicker guage steel that my roof was replaced with recently. I was also home during the instal and could hear them dropping the panels on the roof.The other issue is that the installers refused to use any type of fall restraint or fall arrest equipment. the rear of my home where thry were working is close to 7m off the ground and of steep pitch. I told them to use their safety gear so they wore their harnesses but did not actually attach them to anything, even the rated anchors that I had in place. I even asked them if they were using wifi harnesses due to then not being used properly which they shrugged off.As the home owner, and in particular due to having my Heights ticket, had they fallen off the roof I would have been Liable.My advice, its not worth dealing with them to then have to fight it out legally to have their damage repaired or have to bear the liability of someone falling off your roof because they dont want to follow WHS laws.

Thank you both Gina and PK for the assistance that you have both provided during the installation of my solar system and sucessful Government rebate processes.  Despite my many requests and variations regarding the system installed, and the Government rebate application process, you both have provided a high level of assistance and professionalism with each request without hesitation.  The install guys that attended were quick and cleaned all construction waste prior to leaving and to date, we have not had any issues with the works they performed.  Both my wife and I are truly grateful for your assistance and we are glad that we engaged Sunshine State Solar and Electrical to upgrade our solar panels and battery installation.

After reviewing Solar Quotes blog on how to choose your solar supplier, I asked to be provided with quotes from the 3 suppliers and one from an supplier that I selected, based on word of mouth (Sunshine State Solar).  All 3 quotes I received via Solar Quotes, recommended a 6.6Kwh system. They all were for the same panels but different inverters and were all priced within a five hundred dollars of each other.  Sunshine State Solar recommended a larger 10.5 Kwh system, also using the same components (but a 8.5Kwh inverter and a Hot water Timer).  Their price for the larger systems was lower than for all the other suppliers 6.6Kwh system.  Sunshine State Solar design staff and installers are all accredited.  Sunshine State Solar uses a 3rd party software system to automatically produce a comprehensive quotes (including a detailed return on investment information), which they post online, immediately following my phone call.  in accordance with Solar Quotes recommendations, their quote contained all the information required and they ticked all Solar Quotes boxes for being a reliable supplier, even though they did not appear on Solar Quotes list of recommended suppliers . Using Finns recommendations to review the quote, I had done my own research, I found that the expected average solar production and hence the potential returns, contained in Sunshine States quote, to be wildly inaccurate.  The quote claimed I could expect an average monthly production rate of up to 54Kwh/day, however, as the inverter output was to be limited to 5Kwh, the maximum not average production I could hope to achieve is only around 50Kwh per day.  Fortunately, I did my own math and ignored the sales figures, which still indicated the price would pay for itself in 3 years, so I went ahead based on these figures.  Sunshine State Solar installation was performed within 4 business days of me paying a 10% deposit.  The installation team of three arrived at the agreed time, were extremely experienced and professional leading to a very efficient and satisfactory installation. Sunshine State Solar did all the organising of my grid connection and change over to a smart meter, which was installed 2 weeks after the Solar installation.  I did find that their followup customer service to be little wanting and the Manual provided contained minor missing information which has still not been rectified.  Overall I was happy enough with the products installed, the installation and price, despite some minor annoyances with level of customer service and documentation provided to still recommend them to my neighbor and give them a positive review.
I went through this company, as the salesperson was easy to deal with, and the price was not the cheapest, or the dearest.  But competitive.

The guy on the phone at Sunshine state solar sold me on the system, he was honest, easy to chat with and I liked the guy, very friendly, and FYI I had talked to about 4 others by this stage.  He also just made the quote setup easy, he actually listened and we chated about different options, sizes etc, he didn't push me, but gave his opinion on the best setup to meet the requirements i wanted, the installation had issues, but the installers stayed and got it sorted, great job friendly guys. The system has been running about a month or more, for a 11kw system, I am getting about 8 kw on sunny days, in winter, very happy, I went with AGL 14kw at 10c then 5c for the rest of the day, they just dropped there general kW charge from 22c to 18c just remember in qld power companies can change there amounts at any time so they move all the time, AGL also has an app so I can see exactly what I get and what I use, awesome app. So daily, approx spend $3.50 per day and make about $2.20 per day, when the sun is there, remember ofcourse it's winter, so all in all very happy with sunshine state solar and solar itself.
Well mannered, quality product in panels and inverter, listened to our requirements, best value for products, no installation problems and prompt install.
